description: Pay attention to your own garden #selflove #selfcare
transcript: Be careful of your actions. They will return to you in a way that you least expect it. That alone keeps me focused on the fruits that I bear. The fruit that I bear says a lot about what I planted in previous seasons. Pay attention to your own garden. There may be mold that is growing. There may be weeds that are all over the place. Tend to your own garden and be mindful of the fruits that you bear.
